attackers_goals: Deceive recipients into trusting a visible URL while redirecting them to a different destination, often for phishing, credential harvesting, or malware delivery.
description: An email contains a hyperlink whose display text shows a URL different from the actual destination URL.
investigative_actions: Review the display text URL and the actual destination URL. Verify the reputation and legitimacy of the destination domain. Check whether the sender or domain is known or trusted within the organization.
name: Display text URL differs from actual URL
